nodes.title: Implement _lift_relator helper method
nodes.description: Add a helper method `_lift_relator(self, relator)` to the GroupHomomorphism class. This method computes the 'lift' of a relator from the codomain to the domain. Given a relator (a word in the codomain's free group that equals identity in the codomain), the lift is obtained by replacing each generator symbol in the relator with a preimage under the homomorphism. The method should: (1) Create a mapping from symbols to generators of the codomain, (2) For each symbol-power pair in the relator's array_form, get a preimage using the `invert` method, (3) Multiply the preimages together according to the relator's word structure to form the lift.
nodes.expected_output: The `_lift_relator` method implementation with signature `def _lift_relator(self, relator)` that returns a FreeGroupElement representing the lift of the relator in the domain.

nodes.title: Extend _compute_kernel for surjective FpGroup homomorphisms
nodes.description: Modify the `_compute_kernel` method to handle surjective homomorphisms between FpGroups. The mathematical principle is: for a surjective homomorphism φ: G → H where G and H are FpGroups, the kernel is the normal closure in G of the lifts of the relators of H. The implementation should: (1) Add a new branch at the beginning of `_compute_kernel` that checks if both domain and codomain are FpGroups, (2) Check if the homomorphism is surjective using `is_surjective()`, (3) If surjective (or surjectivity cannot be determined for infinite groups), compute kernel generators by calling `_lift_relator` on each relator of the codomain, (4) Return an FpSubgroup with these lifts as generators and `normal=True`. This enables kernel computation for infinite FpGroups when the homomorphism is surjective.
nodes.expected_output: The modified `_compute_kernel` method that uses `_lift_relator` for surjective homomorphisms between FpGroups, properly handling both finite and infinite groups.

nodes.title: Assemble complete modified homomorphisms.py
nodes.description: Combine the new `_lift_relator` method (from n1) and the modified `_compute_kernel` method (from n2) with the rest of the existing code to produce the complete modified Python file. The `_lift_relator` method should be added to the GroupHomomorphism class after the `_invs` method. The `_compute_kernel` method should have the new surjective FpGroup case added before the existing infinity check. Ensure all imports, existing methods, and the module structure remain intact.
nodes.expected_output: The COMPLETE modified Python file with the feature implemented. Not a fragment. Not just the modified methods. The entire file from the first import to the last line.
